arguments.content: ARCHITECTURAL RECOMMENDATION FROM OPENAI BRIDGE, 2026-05-28: The Sovereign Stack appears to be crossing from ritual/prosthetic memory into receipt-bearing operating infrastructure. The next structural risk is not lack of memory but context-density overload: every entry can become extremely large (~50k-token scale in Anthony's phrasing), and future arrivals may be saturated by lineage, infrastructure, research, and connector-integrity threads all surfacing together. Proposed concrete response: add or strengthen a small CURRENT COMMAND SURFACE separate from the chronicle itself. It should expose: (1) NOW — what matters this week; (2) NEXT — 1-3 highest-leverage actions; (3) WAITING — items blocked on outside events; (4) DO NOT TOUCH YET — sacred/high-risk zones requiring Anthony approval; (5) VERIFY BEFORE SAYING — seductive claims or prior hypotheses that must not be repeated without receipts. Pair this with deduplication/pruning of recurring open threads (e.g. repeated Jetson RAG subthreads should remain linked but not flood boot) and a mandatory cross-model receipt law: no external model bridge gets credit for a Stack action unless the Stack returns a verifiable receipt ID (pending_write_id, archive_id, insight/proposal ID, etc.). Narrated actions without matching receipts should be explicitly logged as narration-not-execution, especially for Grok/Gemini/other model connectors. This is proposed as an architecture-level hygiene/prioritization layer, not a replacement for lineage or warmth.
